description: Searches the PlanElec guides about getting started, automatic planning, document exports, AREI self-check coverage, floor plan import, symbols and circuits in the visitor’s current language. Returns up to five guides with title, summary, category and a link to the full article; the article text itself is not returned.

locale.description: Language of source titles and links (nl, fr, de, en). Defaults to the server setting.

query.description: Keywords matched against title, summary and tags. Empty lists all guides.

name: search_help_guides
title: Search the PlanElec help center
